source_title: Civilization #17: Homer, Vergil, and the War for the Soul of Rome
summary: This November 2024 Rome/Homer/Virgil lecture is an earlier source layer for the existing Imperial Poetry child: Augustus needs a counter-poem to replace Homer in education, recode love as disease, and train piety, obedience, duty, and imperial end-of-history as the Roman soul.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: The real Trojan Horse is Greek culture: logic, philosophy, theater, and beautiful persuasion enter the city and destroy it from within.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The existing Imperial Poetry child already owns inherited-world inversion. This source predates the later Anti-Homer lectures and supplies an earlier classroom formulation of the same Trojan-horse mechanism.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: Aeneas is trained until feeling no longer needs to be interrupted from outside: he recognizes duty himself, kills Turnus, and becomes the embodiment of piety and duty.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The existing anchor already describes the Aeneid as training readers to discard love, pity, and hesitation until obedience feels internal.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: Priam's submission emotionally defeats Achilles, lets Achilles grieve, and turns battlefield rage toward pity, self-reflection, and self-forgiveness.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The Human Heart page already owns the battlefield/forgiveness mechanism. This source is strong support, but the current public page was recently compressed and does not need an ordinary append.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: Homer is the schoolbook and bible of Greek civilization; Augustus therefore needs a Roman epic to remake the Roman soul through education.
existing_lens_links.rationale: Poetry owns language and memorized epic as civilizational medium. The darker inversion belongs to Imperial Poetry rather than a generic Poetry append.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: Virgil's Aeneid enters the reader as a trusted Roman epic while carrying piety, obedience, love-as-disease, and imperial destiny that later Dante must overcome.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The Fictional Heroes / Guide Trap boundary already has a Virgil-interior-guide anchor. This source is background support for why Virgil's interior authority is dangerous.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Use this source in a future replacement/compression pass as the earliest current public-read layer for Imperial Poetry: Augustus' problem is not only rule but education, because Homer still owns the Greek-trained soul. Virgil's answer is a Roman epic that keeps Homeric scenes while making Greek culture a Trojan horse, love a disease, mercy a failed impulse, and piety obedience to imperial mission.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Imperial Poetry owns inherited-world inversion and reader training. Stories owns the parent world-setting mechanism; Poetry owns the medium; Legitimacy Fiction owns Augustan descent and authorization; Human Heart owns love, mercy, and forgiveness as the counter-measure.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Hold as Poetry comparison pressure for epic as educational infrastructure: Homer is the bible of Greek civilization, the schoolbook children memorize, and the medium through which a civilization learns its soul.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Poetry should receive this only when the active mechanism is memorized language and epic as civilizational form. The anti-Homeric imperial inversion belongs to the Imperial Poetry child.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Do not append this source to the parent Stories page directly unless the parent is being compressed. Its story-control pressure is already better scoped to the Imperial Poetry child: familiar beauty and inherited scenes are used to reverse the moral charge of Homeric love and Greek freedom.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Stories remains the parent mechanism. Use the child when the active object is the Aeneid as anti-Homeric training.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Hold the Homeric counter-measure for future Human Heart compression: Priam's forgiveness civilizes Achilles, Odysseus' intimate memory restores identity, and love heals war trauma before Virgil reverses love into disease.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Human Heart owns love, forgiveness, self-forgiveness, and relation as civilizational tests. Imperial Poetry owns the Roman training that treats those goods as dangers.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Hold Odysseus and Aeneas as future comparison pressure for fictional characters as interior structures: Odysseus' bow strings his worldview back together, while Aeneas becomes piety and duty inside the reader trained by the Aeneid.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Fictional Heroes owns the character-in-reader mechanism. Poetry owns the medium; Imperial Poetry owns the political inversion; Human Heart owns the love/trauma repair.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Use only as background support for Augustan authorization: the Julii need a deeper founding line through Aeneas, and old republican liberty must be replaced because Brutus' anti-king identity threatens an emperor.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Legitimacy Fiction owns descent, founding myth, and rightful rule. This source's strongest unresolved pressure is the educational and poetic training layer, not a new Caesar/Augustus legitimacy append.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Hold the Roman end-of-history and Christianity preview only as comparison pressure: the Aeneid makes all history converge on Augustus and Pax Romana, and Jiang says Christianity later makes piety and obedience the cornerstone of society.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Eschatology should not absorb the whole Aeneid source. It owns end-of-history and sacred role-script only when those mechanisms become primary.

chronology_notes.note: Dated 2024-11-21, this source is earlier than the December 5 David legitimacy source and the March 2026 Anti-Homer / Poetry of Empire sources already on the public child page. It should become the origin layer if the child page is next compressed: Augustus needs a Roman epic because Homer still educates the soul after military conquest.

This source states both sides of the mechanism in one lecture: Homer makes love the basis and unifying force of civilization, while Virgil makes love a disease, plague, and danger to imperial destiny.

The final movement should remain chronology-sensitive: Jiang says Rome introduces a conception of reality in which history stops because perfection has been found, but he also says this is not immediately reality and will later need Egypt and Christianity to become durable.

next_actions.action: No immediate public prose mutation is required. The public Imperial Poetry child already carries the Aeneid/Trojan-horse inversion through later, more explicit sources; this impact file records the older origin layer for future replacement/compression.

If provenance maintenance follows, batch it concept-scoped: link the episode's Trojan-horse, love-as-disease, Aeneas-as-piety, and Homer-as-education marks to existing Imperial Poetry / Poetry / Heart anchors rather than adding one isolated backlink.

If public synthesis follows, prefer an Imperial Poetry replacement/compression that reorders chronology around this November 2024 source, December 2024 David, March 2026 Anti-Homer, March 2026 Poetry of Empire, and April 2026 Dante/Virgil before creating any child or standalone page.
